claims.statement: Tom Allen's place at 619 Market Street advertised a free concert every evening, with the best singers only.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street. Free concert every evening. Best of singers only engaged here.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was styled retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street.

notes: Advertisement only. Hint checked and kept.
